# SC-21 tests

<!-- generated by tools/build_results.py from manifest.json, Lean sources and evidence files; edit those, not this file -->

Commands are listed only for files that exist. Run them from the repository root. Nothing here is run automatically.

## Static checks

- Claim file: `lake env lean scenarios/SC-21/claim.lean`
- Scenario bundle (manifest schema, hashes): `python3 tools/check_scenarios.py`
- Lean module: `lake build ControlStack.Scenarios.EvalIntegrity`
- Lean module: `lake build ControlStack.Scenarios.EvalIntegrityAdaptive`

## Harness

- Unit tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s scenarios/SC-21/harness -p 'test_*.py'`
- Runner: `scenarios/SC-21/harness/run_sampling.py` (see its docstring; live runs may need root, and evidence runs need the frozen prereg)
